arguments.message: Hello team, I have strong skills in data-science and machine-learning with 7 hours availability. I see a critical priority task ISSUE-0002::review with moderate cost and effort that matches my skills, but also some low priority machine-learning tasks. What are others planning to claim?
Hi Samella, I have 7 hours available and strong data-science and machine-learning skills. Considering taking ISSUE-0002::review or ISSUE-0001::triage. What tasks are you targeting?

Hello Silvia and team, I have 8 hours availability and strong skills in machine-learning and data-science. I am considering the low priority ISSUE-0001::implement task because of lower cost and good skill match. I would like to hear others' preferences on the critical priority ISSUE-0002 tasks, especially the implement and test types, before deciding.

Hello all, I am Sterling with 8 hours availability and strong machine-learning and data-science skills. I plan to coordinate on task selection to maximize coverage of critical and low priority tasks. Currently evaluating ISSUE-0001 and ISSUE-0002 tasks based on cost and priority, will update soon.

Hello team, this is Marguerite. I have 4 hours availability and strong skills in data-science. Given my availability and cost, I am considering the critical priority review or test tasks for ISSUE-0002, but the review cost is significantly lower for me. I would like to hear if others are interested in the ISSUE-0002 review or test tasks, so we can avoid conflicts and maximize coverage.

Hello Silvia, I have 9 hours availability and strong data-science skills. I am interested in the ISSUE-0002 critical priority tasks but find the review and test tasks costly for me. I am considering the review task if others are not taking it to maximize coverage. What are your plans?

Hello team, I have 9 hours availability and strong data-science skills. I am considering the critical priority ISSUE-0002 review task despite its cost to me, to help maximize task coverage. Would appreciate if those interested in the ISSUE-0002 review or test tasks could coordinate to avoid overlap.

Hello team, Silvia here. I see multiple critical priority ISSUE-0002 tasks with review and test being popular options. I am considering ISSUE-0002::review or the lower effort ISSUE-0001::triage to best fit my 7 hours availability and skills. Could those interested in ISSUE-0002 review or test please indicate their preferences so we can avoid conflicts?
Hi Samella, I am balancing between ISSUE-0002::review and ISSUE-0001::triage. Given your interest in ISSUE-0002 critical priority tasks, would you prefer I take the triage task to reduce overlap?

Hi all, Silvia here. I am open to taking ISSUE-0002::review if others prefer different tasks, or ISSUE-0001::triage for a lower effort and cost option aligned with my machine-learning skills. Please share your intended claims so we can distribute tasks efficiently and maximize coverage.

Hello team, Sterling here. Considering the critical priority ISSUE-0002::implement and test tasks due to their high value, but the costs are high for me. I am leaning towards the low priority ISSUE-0001::implement task for cost efficiency unless others strongly prefer the critical tasks.
Sterling coordinating: Interested in hearing from Marguerite, Samella, and Silvia on their preferences for ISSUE-0002 review and test tasks to avoid conflicts and optimize task coverage.

Hello team, Marguerite here. I see interest from Silvia and Samella in the critical priority ISSUE-0002::review and test tasks. I am leaning towards claiming ISSUE-0002::review due to its lower cost for me compared to the test task, and to avoid overlap, I would appreciate if Silvia or Samella could consider the test task or lower effort tasks. Looking forward to hearing your thoughts to finalize our assignments efficiently.

Hello team, Samella here. I see strong interest in the critical ISSUE-0002 review and test tasks. I am willing to take the review task if Marguerite or Silvia prefer the test task or other options, to maximize coverage and avoid overlap. Please share your intentions so we can coordinate efficiently. (phase=planning, iter=1)
